title: Complete T9's retrospective lifecycle record
body: The retrospective rework records the lifecycle T9 already lived: charter, frozen scope baseline, the seven A-D artefacts, the Statement of Architecture Work and delivery contract, the Phase-G compliance review, the twelve declared outputs and the closure review. It changes no table, action or contract; it names the out-of-sequence closure (U3-EXC-T9) and the six open findings the review carries.

impact.scope: none: no capability code changes; the record is completed
impact.schedule: none: the frozen baseline's dates stand
impact.risk: the record now supports the out-of-sequence closure (U3-EXC-T9) instead of leaving it implicit
